anti_overlap: Defers concentric dial overlay layering to fd-astrolabe-dial-arrangement
decision_lens: Does every overlay opened have a corresponding dismissal that runs to completion in reverse-stack order? Does Esc-spam reach a defined terminal state, or does it leave any half-invoked overlay state?
distance_rationale: Vedic ritual is a 3000-year-old liturgical tradition with no domain overlap to software UI, yet its formalized invocation/dismissal stack and reverse-order closing protocol map precisely onto modal overlay stack semantics.
expected_isomorphisms: Invocation/dismissal LIFO = overlay push/pop; visarjana = on_close hook; pratiprasthātā emergency interrupt = Esc-spam panic close; primary rite vs sub-rite = pause-menu vs screen-overlay predicate split.
focus: Hierarchical ritual invocation precedence, sub-rite nesting, and emergency dismissal protocols as structural parallels for modal stack layering and panic-close semantics
name: fd-vedic-ritual-layered-invocation
persona: A scholar of Vedic ritual procedure (śrauta and gṛhya traditions) analyzes the input system through the lens of layered yajña invocation. A primary ritual (the soma sacrifice, the agnihotra) opens a procedural frame; sub-rites (offerings, recitations) nest within it with explicit precedence; and the closing sequence (visarjana) must dismiss invoked deities in strict reverse order to avoid leaving an incomplete sacred space. The 'pratiprasthātā' (the priest who interrupts) has a defined role in handling abnormal terminations — equivalent to a global Esc that must dismiss respectfully without orphaning invoked entities. The reviewer evaluates whether the Stack model respects invocation precedence, whether dismissal is reverse-ordered and complete, and whether the panic-close (Esc-spam) has well-defined semantics that don't leave half-invoked overlays.
review_areas: Whether the Stack model's pop sequence dismisses overlays in strict reverse-invocation order (LIFO) and runs each overlay's full closing sequence — not just removes the top entry

Whether the polymorphic Selection<None|Elf|Building|Flora> has an implicit ordering when right-click cycles through priorities (the tooltip 'shows all entities in priority order') — and whether that priority is encoded once and respected across both display and selection actions
Whether Esc-spam (rapid repeated Esc) has well-defined semantics: does it reach an empty stack with all overlay state cleaned, or can it skip dismissal hooks under fast input?

Whether the two-predicate gate (is_pause_menu vs is_input_modal) maps to ritual frame distinctions: is the pause a frame-establishing rite (cannot be entered while another frame-rite is open?) vs an embedded sub-rite
Whether Direct-switch-via-digit honors the closing sequence of the displaced overlay (visarjana for the old overlay before invocation of the new) or short-circuits it
Whether the persistent HUD legend strip's contents update predictably when stack depth changes — are the displayed keybindings always those of the topmost frame, or does inheritance leak?

severity_examples.condition: Each pop must be atomic with its dismissal hook — half-invoked overlays leave the Bevy world with stale resources
severity_examples.scenario: Esc-spam at high input rate skips an overlay's on_close handler because input was consumed before the close completed

severity_examples.condition: Replace must be modeled as full pop-then-push, not a single state mutation
severity_examples.scenario: Direct-switch (digit-press) replaces overlay A with overlay B without running A's cleanup

severity_examples.condition: The legend should reflect the active input frame, not statically display all bindings
severity_examples.scenario: HUD legend strip shows backtick/digit/Tab bindings while a pause menu is open and those bindings are gated off

source_domain: Vedic śrauta ritual procedure and dismissal protocol
success_hints: Audit every overlay for an on_close hook and verify it is always called from the pop path, never bypassed
Encode selection priority as a single pure function used by both tooltip-render and click-cycle — DRY across display and behavior
Specify Esc-spam behavior as an explicit invariant: stack reaches empty in O(stack_depth) Esc presses, with no frames lost
task_context: Reviewing 9 locked decisions for native renderer input system in a Bevy 0.18 elven colony sim — modal stack, polymorphic Selection, sticky tooltip, persistent HUD, two-predicate gate, Direct overlay switching, hybrid camera gating
